subject: Embeddings & Rerank migration kickoff — index backfill discussion
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Daniel Cho <daniel.cho@nimblesearch.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-03-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Embeddings & Rerank migration kickoff — index backfill discussion

Hi Daniel,

Great to meet you last week — thanks for the context on NimbleSearch's rerank pilot. I want to kick off the migration/onboarding plan so we can line up resources for the index backfill and reranking evaluation. High-level asks for this thread:

- Confirm target index size (estimated number of documents + average doc length).
- Preferred vector DB (if you already have one) and any constraints (multi-AZ, encryption-at-rest).
- Which rerank metric matters most (MRR, NDCG@10, Recall@100, human evals?).
- Any compliance requirements for data handling (S3 region, retention windows).

Attached: customer_requirements.xlsx (SLA/ingestion notes).

Proposed plan (short):
1) Quick design review + tradeoffs on vector DB (week 1)
2) Small-scale backfill + embeddings sanity checks (week 2)
3) Rerank evals with templated prompts + metric sweep (week 3)
4) Full index backfill and monitoring + handoff to CS (week 4)

Can you confirm the index size and whether you prefer us to backfill embeddings (Redwood-hosted) vs. you running embedding jobs into your DB? If you want Redwood to run backfills, we'll need S3 access (or an export) and a short SLA for transfer.

Thanks — happy to schedule a 30-min kickoff tomorrow or Thursday.

Best,
Monica Patel
Account Exec, Redwood Inference
--
Attachment: customer_requirements.xlsx (xlsx)
From: Daniel Cho <daniel.cho@nimblesearch.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Sophie Park <sophie@nimblesearch.com>
Date: 2026-03-01T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Embeddings & Rerank migration kickoff — index backfill discussion

Monica — thanks for the clear plan. A few answers up front:

- Estimated index: ~2.1M documents, avg 450 tokens. We have some long-form docs but most are short pages.
- Vector DB: currently evaluating Milvus + RedisVector; we don't have a final decision. We'd prefer multi-AZ and encryption.
- Rerank metric: primary is NDCG@10, secondary is MRR. We also run a small human-blind eval for quality checks.
- Compliance: data sits in us-east-1 S3. Retention policy is 2 years; we need to log all access.

We can either:
A) Give Redwood S3 read-only access and you run the embedding/backfill pipeline; or
B) Provide precomputed embeddings and we handle ingestion to our vector DB.

Option A is preferred if Redwood can guarantee throughput and a brief network egress estimate. Sophie and I are available for a kickoff 2026-03-02 10:00–11:30 PT.

Thanks,
Daniel
Dir. of Search Engineering, NimbleSearch
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Daniel Cho <daniel.cho@nimblesearch.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-03-02T08:44:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Embeddings & Rerank migration kickoff — index backfill discussion

Thanks Daniel — that's helpful. Quick notes and a concrete proposal: 

On DB choice: Milvus is a solid open-source option for large indices; RedisVector is great for low-latency lookups with Redis infra. If you want managed simplicity + analytics, Redwood can host the vector index layer for the backfill and then hand over the exported embeddings/indices if you want to self-host later. Key tradeoffs: export size, snapshot time, and cold-start latency for very large indices. I'll attach a short playbook that outlines these tradeoffs.

Proposal (we recommend Option A):
- Redwood runs the initial embedding job and backfill into a temporary managed vector cluster (multi-AZ, encrypted).
- We coordinate a dry-run ingestion for 100k docs this week (sanity checks on embeddings, retrieval, and rerank costs).
- For rerank evals: we'll run NDCG@10 sweeps and a small human-blind study. We'll share rerank_eval_template.csv to capture your judgment labels.

Reqs from your side to proceed with Option A:
1) Grant a cross-account S3 role with read-only to s3://nimblesearch-datasets (or provide a signed URL tarball).
2) Expected bandwidth window (we estimate ~600 GB to transfer embeddings for 2.1M docs if using 1536-d vectors at float16).
3) Any IP allowlists for Redwood worker IPs.

I've attached: embeddings-migration-playbook.pdf. Rishi, can you confirm resource availability if we greenlight the backfill?

If that sounds good, let's lock the kickoff for 2026-03-02 10:00 PT.

Best,
Monica
--
Attachment: embeddings-migration-playbook.pdf (pdf)
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
To: Daniel Cho <daniel.cho@nimblesearch.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-03-02T09:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Embeddings & Rerank migration kickoff — index backfill discussion

Hi Daniel / Monica — looping in CS onboarding items and a lightweight checklist so we can hit the SLA once the backfill completes. Action items below and I've attached a small CSV template for rerank labels.

CS onboarding checklist (short):
- Access & security: confirm S3 role, allowlist, and audit log expectations.
- Data sampling: provide a 50k sample export (s3://nimblesearch-datasets/samples/50k) so we can run the sanity pipeline.
- Eval plan: confirm list of queries + expected intents; we'll run the NDCG sweep and two human judges per query.
- Monitoring: set up alerting for recall regressions and token/compute burn.

Attachment: rerank_eval_template.csv (csv)

Quoted from Monica below for context:
> Proposal (we recommend Option A):
> - Redwood runs the initial embedding job and backfill into a temporary managed vector cluster (multi-AZ, encrypted).
> - We coordinate a dry-run ingestion for 100k docs this week (sanity checks on embeddings, retrieval, and rerank costs).

Daniel — can you confirm the sample export location and whether your infra team can create the cross-account role by EOD 2026-03-03? That will determine whether we can start the 100k dry-run on Friday.

Thanks,
Evelyn Hart
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
--
Attachment: rerank_eval_template.csv (csv)
From: Daniel Cho <daniel.cho@nimblesearch.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Cc: Sophie Park <sophie@nimblesearch.com>
Date: 2026-03-04T15:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Embeddings & Rerank migration kickoff — index backfill discussion

All — good progress here. Sophie and I confirmed with infra: we'll provision a cross-account role for read-only S3 and place the 50k sample at s3://nimblesearch-datasets/samples/50k by 2026-03-03 20:00 UTC. We'll also provide an S3 manifest and a short README.

We prefer Redwood to run the initial backfill (Option A). Please proceed with the dry-run ingestion. Sophie will share an invite for the kickoff meeting 2026-03-05 10:00 PT; we should use that slot for the design review plus a quick demo of a 100k backfill.

Two quick asks from our side before the dry-run:
- Provide an estimate for egress during the backfill and whether you will compress embeddings (float16) before transfer.
- Share the rerank_eval_template.csv filled with a placeholder set so our judges understand the format.

Thanks, looking forward to the kickoff.

Daniel
Dir. of Search Engineering, NimbleSearch
